cost.cost_usd_basis: measured as zero because zero tokens were charged: no provider seam was configured, so no request was sent. local.excluded_from_the_timing: HTTP, JSON serialization, sqlite persistence, the evidence ledger and the export renderer. This is pipeline latency, not end-to-end API latency, and the two must not be quoted as one another
local.model_access: no provider seam was configured, so the pipeline made zero model calls. That zero is a configuration fact, not an efficiency result: everything the pack declares resolves deterministically and every ambiguous label goes to the review tray, which is the configuration the product promises works
local.what_is_timed: extract_ms is the format adapter; map_ms is pipeline.process_document, which is retrieval, mapping, unit conversion and the gate; total_ms is their sum
